environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING override to COUNT, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK action, (3) a custom rule with a RegexPatternSet matching on SingleQueryArgument 'value' with pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|\bor\b\s+\d+\s*=\s*\d+|'\s*--)`  action BLOCK. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch logging enabled for WAF with sampled requests retained for 3 hours.
